title: docs(adr): ADR-0095 D1 dated note — Layer 0 is inert on the platform identity objects; Layer 1 silence means the object's declared default row scope, a protocol key (#24164 ruling E′; Tier H)
body:
Filed by the director seat (summon #43 continuation 5, `session_01QJC7i981TSs9L1CGJK59Ax`) from objectstack-ai/objectstack#24164, ruled E′ (batch #365 item 4). Tier H (`docs/adr/**`): the maintainer merges. It lands before the code: the collection-point card (filed in this act; numbers in the ruling comment on #24164) and the declarations card (filed in this act; numbers in the ruling comment on #24164) are blocked on it and on the spec key #24338. ⛔ Not a claim. `Clause-②: no` (a note; the contract key is #24338).

## What changes
- ADR-0095 D1 (`docs/adr/0095-*.md`): one dated note (2026-10-18, #24164 ruling E′): the seven SCIM projections and the better-auth-managed identity tables (`sys_user`, `sys_session`, `sys_account`, `sys_team_member`, `sys_two_factor`, `sys_user_preference`, `sys_api_key`, `sys_device_code`, `sys_oauth_*`, `sys_organization`, `sys_verification`, `sys_jwks`, `sys_audit_log`) carry no organisation column, so Layer 0 is inert on them; Layer 1 silence (no held set carries a row policy) means the object's declared default row scope, not 「no filter」; the default is a protocol key on the object (#24338), declared by the platform objects themselves (the declarations card (filed in this act; numbers in the ruling comment on #24164)), applied at the one collection point (the collection-point card (filed in this act; numbers in the ruling comment on #24164)); an `extend` contributor cannot loosen it. Mainstream precedent in one line (Salesforce OWD on the object; Dataverse ownership type on the table; PostgreSQL `CREATE POLICY ON table`).
- A cross-reference from ADR-0090 D12's 2026-10-17 note (#23960 ruling B): #24136 keeps its three conditions; no fourth condition.
- About 15 lines; no other ADR text changes.

## Acceptance
- The note cites the ruling comment on #24164 and the four cards; the ADR lint in `pnpm check` is green; no changeset (docs).
